protocol.design: A full-rank box perturbation of a coupled-capacity latent line, with orthogonal nuisance columns of total radius eta. All 135 paired conditions are retained, including large nuisance radii. All parameters reproduce a saturated source-box observation. Query and anchor costs are shared across matched conditions and explicitly separated from certification cost.

warnings: Solution may be inaccurate. Try another solver, adjusting the solver settings, or solve with verbose=True for more information.
scope: Full-rank anisotropic parameter boxes. Scalar paths plus Hausdorff envelopes validate risk brackets; no full multidimensional partition or global minimax reference is computed. Paired conditions share query and anchor measurements. Floating-point primal/dual diagnostics are not interval certification.
